en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped public garden with paths, hedges, and neatly trimmed trees. In the foreground is an ornate metal fence and gate; just inside stands a gardener holding a tool. Behind him are greenhouses and a small house with a steep tiled roof and flower boxes. On the wooded hill in the background stand large, decorative villas or mansions and, on the skyline, a slender lattice observation tower reminiscent of early 20th‑century European iron towers.
